cohort: 103 pregnant women diagnosed with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) who delivered at a tertiary care centre between May 2023 and August 2023.
finding: The study found a higher prevalence of GDM among primigravida and increased rates of Caesarean sections, PIH, preterm delivery, IUFD, and NICU admissions in GDM pregnancies.
mod_finding: The study observed that 50.4% of GDM women had a Caesarean section, indicating raised Caesarean section rates among this cohort.
